DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仲間の集合写真を撮りたいのですが、写りたくない人もいます。全員並ぶように頼む前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合写真を撮りたいが写りたくない人がいるため、全員に並んでもらう前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take a group photo of my friends, but some people do not want to be in it. I would like advice before asking everyone to line up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice before having everyone line up for a group photo because some people do not want to be photographed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方は撮影自体を避けたいのですか。それとも写真の公開を避けたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do they want to avoid being photographed at all, or avoid having the photo made public?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 撮影されることを断っています。公開しなければ写ってもよいという意味に変えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: その人は公開だけでなく撮影自体を断っているので、公開しなければ写ってよいとは解釈しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have refused to be photographed. I do not want to reinterpret that as permission to include them as long as I do not publish the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the person has refused photography itself, not just publication, so you will not interpret that as permission to include them if the photo is not published. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、撮影に参加する方だけで位置を決めましょう。断った方に撮影係を頼む予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please arrange positions only for those participating in the photo. Do you plan to ask the person who declined to take the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。断ったから撮影係をするべきだとは思いません。私が撮って、私の写真は後で希望する人に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 断った人に撮影係を押しつけず自分が撮り、自分の写真は後で希望する人に頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I do not think declining means they should be the photographer. I will take it myself, and later ask someone willing to take a photo of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not make the person who declined take the photo; you will take it yourself and later ask someone willing to photograph you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 役割を押しつけずに相談できますね。ほかの利用者が背景に入らない場所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can discuss it without imposing a role on anyone. Please also find a place where other park users will not appear in the background.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路をふさがず、背景に人が入ったら待ちます。写真のために他の人へ移動を強く求めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路をふさがず、背景に人が入れば待ち、撮影のために他の利用者を無理に動かさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not block the path, and I will wait if someone enters the background. I will not pressure others to move for our photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not block the path, will wait if someone enters the background, and will not force other park users to move for the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周りに配慮して撮影してください。公開については、写る方の希望も別に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please be considerate of those around you when taking photos. Separately check the wishes of those photographed about making the photo public.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 参加したい人だけで私が撮ります。撮影と公開は別々に確認し、断った人へ役割を押しつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加したい人だけで撮り、撮影と公開への希望を別々に確認し、断った人に役割を押しつけないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the photo with only those who want to participate. I will check photography and publication separately and will not impose a role on anyone who declines.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph only willing participants, check their wishes about photography and publication separately, and not impose roles on those who decline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。皆さんで気持ちよくお過ごしください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I hope everyone enjoys their time here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 列車に傘を忘れました。滝川に着いた時刻を手掛かりに、問い合わせ先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車に傘を忘れたので、到着時刻を手掛かりに照会先を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella on the train. I would like to know where to inquire, using the time I arrived in Takikawa as a clue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left an umbrella on the train and want to know where to inquire using your arrival time as a clue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何時ごろ、どこから乗りましたか。降りた時刻は何で確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time and at which station did you board? How did you check the time you got off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅を出てから送ったメッセージが四時でした。降りたのはその少し前ですが、四時着とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅を出てから送ったメッセージが四時で、降りたのは少し前なので四時着とは断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A message I sent after leaving the station was at four. I got off a little before that, so it does not necessarily mean the train arrived at four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the message you sent after leaving the station was at four and you got off shortly before, so you cannot conclude the train arrived at four. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信時刻と到着時刻は違いますね。乗った駅や乗車券の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sending time and arrival time are different, then. Do you have a record of your boarding station or ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗った駅は覚えています。券の写真もありました。写真の撮影時刻を列車の出発時刻にせず、券の内容を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車駅と券の写真はあるが、写真の撮影時刻を出発時刻とせず券の内容を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I remember the station where I boarded. I also found a photo of my ticket. I will show the ticket details rather than treat the photo's timestamp as the train's departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you know the boarding station and have a ticket photo, but will show the ticket details rather than treat the photo's timestamp as the departure time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録と覚えている区間で、利用列車を確認しましょう。傘はどのあたりに置きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us identify the train using your records and the section you remember traveling. Where did you leave the umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座席の横に立てました。何号車かは覚えていません。最後尾だったと思いますが、確かではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 傘は座席の横に置き、号車は覚えておらず最後尾という記憶も不確かだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I stood it beside my seat. I do not remember the car number. I think it was the last car, but I will make clear that I am unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the umbrella was beside your seat, you do not remember the car number, and even your memory of being in the last car is uncertain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確実な点と不確かな点を分ければ照会しやすくなります。傘の特徴もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Distinguishing certain from uncertain details will help us inquire. Please describe the umbrella too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い長い傘で、持ち手に白いテープがあります。乗車駅と券、送信前に降りたことを伝え、号車は未確認とします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い長い傘の持ち手に白いテープがあること、乗車駅と券、送信前に降りたことを示し、号車は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is a long blue umbrella with white tape on the handle. I will provide my boarding station and ticket and explain that I got off before sending the message, while leaving the car number unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe a long blue umbrella with white tape on its handle, provide your boarding station and ticket, explain you got off before sending the message, and say the car number is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。忘れ物の照会先をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell you where to inquire about lost property. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手続きについて何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先からこの住所変更用紙をもらいました。市役所に出すものだと思って持ってきたので、提出先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先の住所変更用紙を市役所に出すと思って持参したので、提出先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My employer gave me this change-of-address form. I brought it here thinking I should submit it to city hall, so I would like to check where it should go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought your employer’s change-of-address form thinking it was for city hall, and want to confirm where to submit it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙の宛先や提出方法は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the form state a recipient or submission method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人事部へ社内システムで提出とありました。市役所に出す用紙ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙には人事部へ社内システムで提出するとあり、市役所向けではなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to submit it to Human Resources through the internal company system. It was not a form for city hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the form says to submit it to Human Resources through the company’s internal system and was not intended for city hall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先の手続きですね。行政の転居手続きは、別に済ませていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then it is a workplace procedure. Have you separately completed the government procedure for your move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、担当へ届けました。ただ、役所で済んだから会社にも自動で伝わると考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行政の転居届は済ませたが、会社にも自動で伝わると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I notified the person in charge. But I thought completing it at city hall meant my company would be notified automatically too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you completed the government change-of-address notification but thought the company would also be notified automatically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先への連絡は勤務先の案内を確認してください。こちらの届出と同じ手続きではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your employer’s guidance for notifying them. It is not the same procedure as the notification here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の用紙には通勤経路の欄もあります。役所への届出に書いた内容をそのまま全部写さず、会社の必要事項を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社の用紙には通勤経路もあり、役所への届出を全部写さず会社の必要事項を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company’s form also has a commuting-route field. Rather than copy everything from the government notification, I will check what my company requires.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the company form also asks for your commuting route, and you will check the company’s requirements rather than copy the whole government notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の指定に沿って確認しましょう。行政手続きで追加の相談があれば担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the recipient’s instructions. If you have further questions about government procedures, let the person in charge know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は社内用紙をここへ提出しません。会社の案内で住所と通勤経路を入力し、人事部へ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 社内用紙は窓口に出さず、会社の案内に沿って住所と通勤経路を入力し、人事部へ提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not submit the internal company form here today. I will enter my address and commuting route following my company’s guidance and send it to Human Resources.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not submit the internal company form at this counter, but will enter your address and commuting route following company guidance and submit it to Human Resources. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。提出先をご確認いただきありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking where to submit it. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の準備で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you prepare for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紹介状を持ってきましたが、似た封筒が二つあります。領収書の方と取り違えていないか、受付で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た封筒が二つあるので、紹介状と領収書を取り違えていないか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my referral letter, but I have two similar envelopes. I would like reception to check that I have not confused it with the receipt envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have two similar envelopes and want to check that you have not mixed up the referral letter and receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の表に書いてある宛先や書類名は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you read the recipient or document name written on the envelopes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つはこの病院宛てです。もう一つは自分の名前で、中に領収書があると前の受付で言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一つは病院宛てで、もう一つは自分宛ての領収書だと以前の受付で聞いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is addressed to this hospital. The other has my name, and the previous reception desk told me it contains receipts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one envelope is addressed to the hospital and that the previous reception desk told you the other contains receipts addressed to you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 病院宛ての封筒を担当が確認します。どちらかの封を開けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the envelope addressed to the hospital. Have you opened either one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらも開けていません。領収書の封筒は不要だと思って捨てそうになりましたが、二つとも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: どちらも未開封で、領収書は不要と思って捨てかけたが両方持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have opened neither. I almost threw away the receipt envelope thinking it was unnecessary, but I brought both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say both envelopes are unopened and you brought both, although you nearly discarded the receipts thinking they were unnecessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認前に捨てずに持参されたのですね。領収書を診療の書類として渡す必要があるかも担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You brought them without discarding anything before checking. We will also ask the person in charge whether the receipts need to be handed over as medical documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紹介状だけだと決めて片方を置いて帰るのではなく、必要な物と返してもらう物を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片方を不要と決めつけず、受付に渡す書類と返してもらう書類を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to assume only the referral letter is needed and leave one behind. I would like to check what is required and what will be returned to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not want to assume one envelope is unnecessary, and want to check which documents reception needs and which will be returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取る書類を確認してお知らせします。ご自身で保管する書類は取り違えずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check which documents to accept and let you know. Please keep the documents for your own records without mixing them up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病院宛ての封筒と自分宛ての封筒を分けて見せます。必要書類を確認して、返された方を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 病院宛てと自分宛ての封筒を分けて示し、必要書類を確認して返却された物を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the envelope addressed to the hospital separately from the one addressed to me. I will confirm the required documents and take home whichever is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the hospital-addressed and self-addressed envelopes separately, confirm the required documents, and take home what is returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が確認しますので、そのままお持ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep them as they are while the person in charge checks them. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たりません。駐輪場からなくなったと思いますが、今朝の場所を思い出す手伝いをしてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車が見当たらないので、盗難を疑う前に今朝置いた場所を思い出したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find my bicycle. I think it disappeared from the bicycle parking area, but I would like help remembering where I left it this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot find your bicycle and want to remember where you parked this morning before suspecting theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に置いた場所を、どのように覚えていますか。写真やメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How do you remember the last place you parked it? Do you have a photo or note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の右だと思いました。でも、昨日は右で、今日は雨を避けて屋根のある左へ置いた気もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日は入口の右に置いたが、今日は雨を避けて屋根のある左に置いたかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was to the right of the entrance. But yesterday it was on the right, and today I may have put it on the covered left side to avoid the rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you parked to the right of the entrance yesterday but may have put it under the roof on the left today to avoid the rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二日の記憶が混ざっているのですね。左側はもう確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your memories of the two days are mixed, then. Have you checked the left side yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ右だけです。なくなったと届ける前に、安全に行ける左側を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右側しか見ていないため、紛失の届け出前に安全に行ける左側を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only the right so far. Before reporting it missing, I would like to check the left side, which I can safely reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have checked only the right side and want to safely check the left before reporting the bicycle missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できたら結果をお知らせください。特徴や鍵はご自身で確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us the result once you have checked. Can you check the bicycle’s features and lock yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左側を見て戻ってきました。似た自転車がありましたが、色だけで自分の物とは決めません。鍵と防犯登録の控えで確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左側で似た自転車を見つけたが色だけで判断せず、鍵と防犯登録の控えで確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked the left side and came back. There was a similar bicycle, but I will not assume it is mine from the color alone. I will check with my key and bicycle registration receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you found a similar bicycle on the left but will check it with your key and registration receipt rather than judge by color alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの人の自転車を動かさず、確認してください。ご自身の物と確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check without moving anyone else’s bicycle. Have you confirmed it is yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵が合い、控えの番号も一致しました。今日は左に置いたようです。盗難ではなく、置いた場所の勘違いでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵と控えの番号が一致したので、盗難ではなく置いた場所を勘違いしていたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The key fits, and the number matches my registration receipt. It seems I parked on the left today. It was not theft; I had mistaken where I left it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that the key and registration receipt number match, so it was a mistake about the parking location rather than theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。今後も特徴を確かめてから動かしてください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you found it. Please continue to check its features before moving it. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請書に返信用の封筒を入れます。返事は自宅で受け取りたいのですが、封筒の住所が勤務先になっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請書に入れる返信用封筒が勤務先宛てになっており、自宅で返事を受け取りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will enclose a return envelope with my application. I want the reply at home, but the envelope is addressed to my workplace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because the return envelope for your application is addressed to your workplace but you want the reply at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その住所はご自身で書きましたか。それとも申請先から指定されたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you write that address yourself, or did the application recipient specify it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の申請で使った封筒を写しました。今回の申請先が勤務先を指定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前の申請の封筒を写しただけで、今回の申請先が勤務先を指定したわけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I copied an envelope from a previous application. The recipient of this application did not specify my workplace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you merely copied an envelope used for a previous application, and this application’s recipient did not specify your workplace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信用封筒の宛先と、申請先へ送る外側の宛先を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the return envelope’s address separately from the outer envelope addressed to the application recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外側は申請先です。内側だけ自宅へ直したいです。両方を自宅に直して、申請先へ届かなくするのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外側は申請先のままにして内側だけ自宅宛てにし、両方を自宅宛てに変えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The outer envelope is for the application recipient. I want to change only the inner envelope to my home. I want to avoid changing both to my home and preventing the application from reaching its recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the outer envelope will remain addressed to the application recipient and only the inner one will be changed to your home, rather than changing both. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請先の返信用封筒の指定もご覧ください。訂正した封筒を使えるかは、指定に沿って確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also read the recipient’s requirements for the return envelope. Check whether a corrected envelope is acceptable according to those requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 訂正が読みにくいので、返信用は新しい封筒に書き直します。必要な料金や大きさも指定を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正すると読みにくいので返信用封筒を書き直し、料金と大きさも申請先の指定で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The correction is hard to read, so I will write a new return envelope. I will also check the specified postage and size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the correction would be hard to read, so you will rewrite the return envelope and check the application recipient’s postage and size requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備が整ったら、外側と内側をもう一度確認してください。封をした後に中身を忘れないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is ready, check the outer and inner envelopes again. Make sure you have not forgotten anything inside before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信用は自宅、外側は申請先と確認します。書類と指定どおりの返信用封筒を入れてから封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信用は自宅、外側は申請先と照合し、書類と指定に合う返信用封筒を入れてから封をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check that the return envelope is addressed to my home and the outer one to the application recipient. I will put in the documents and the return envelope meeting the requirements before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the return envelope is for home and the outer envelope for the application recipient, then enclose the documents and compliant return envelope before sealing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送の準備ができましたらお声がけください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when it is ready to send. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座の記録について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your account records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家計を整理したいので、取引の記録を見たいです。給料の月と買い物の月をどこで区切るか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家計の整理で口座の記録を見たいが、給与や買い物をどの月に分けるか迷っていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to look at my transaction records to organize my household budget. I am unsure where to draw the line between salary months and shopping months.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about viewing your account records to organize your budget because you are unsure which months to assign salary and shopping to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知りたいのは口座へ入った日と出た日ですか。それとも商品を購入した日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you want to know when money entered and left the account, or the dates you purchased items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず口座の入出金を調べたいです。給料の対象月を、そのまま入金した月にして考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まず口座の入出金を調べたく、給与の対象月を入金月と同じだと考えていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, I would like to check deposits and withdrawals. I had been treating the month the salary was for as the same month in which it was deposited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you first want to check account deposits and withdrawals and had assumed the salary’s applicable month was the deposit month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座の記録は実際の取引日で見ましょう。どの期間の入出金を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at account records by the actual transaction dates. What period’s deposits and withdrawals do you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四月一日から末日までです。三月分の給料でも四月に入ったなら、その期間の入金として確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四月一日から末日を対象に、三月分の給与でも四月の入金ならその期間に含めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: From April 1 through the end of April. Even if the salary is for March, I want to include it as a deposit in that period if it entered the account in April.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want the period from April 1 through month-end and want to include March salary if it was deposited in April. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象期間が決まりましたね。カードの買い物日と口座からの引落日も違う場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The period is settled, then. The card purchase date and the date money is debited from the account may also differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買い物のレシートは別に整理します。口座の記録だけで、四月に買った物すべてがわかるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買い物のレシートは別に整理し、口座の記録だけで四月の購入品が全て分かるとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will organize shopping receipts separately. I will not assume that account records alone show everything I bought in April.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will organize shopping receipts separately and will not assume account records alone reveal all your April purchases. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認希望期間は四月一日から末日までの口座の入出金、と記録しました。三月分給与でも四月の入金ならこの期間に含めます。購入日を整理するレシートの表とは別です。記録の取得方法は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I recorded your requested period as account deposits and withdrawals from April 1 through month-end. March salary deposited in April is included in that period. This is separate from the receipt table organized by purchase date. I will ask the person in charge how to obtain the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座は四月の実際の取引日で確認します。給料の対象月と買い物日は別の表に書き、同じ日付として扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座は四月の実際の取引日で確認し、給与の対象月と購入日は別の表に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the account by actual April transaction dates. I will write the month the salary is for and shopping dates in a separate table rather than treating them as the same dates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the account using actual April transaction dates and record the salary’s applicable month and purchase dates in a separate table. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録の確認についてご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will explain how to check the records. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。売場で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the sales area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて自分でお米を買います。電子レンジはありますが炊飯器がないので、どの品か表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電子レンジはあるが炊飯器はなく、初めて買う米の商品表示を確認したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am buying rice myself for the first time. I have a microwave but no rice cooker, so I would like to look at the labels to see which product to choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the rice product labels because this is your first purchase and you have a microwave but no rice cooker. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋のお米と、調理済みのパックを比べたいのですね。普段は何食分使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want to compare bagged rice with ready-cooked packs, then. How many meals do you usually need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一日一食です。袋の米をそのまま電子レンジで温めればよいと思っていましたが、作り方を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一日一食分が必要で、生米もそのまま温められると思っていたため、調理方法を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One meal a day. I thought I could simply heat bagged rice in the microwave as it is, but I would like to check how to prepare it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you need one meal a day and thought raw rice could simply be heated as it is, so you want to learn how to cook it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生のお米と調理済みの商品は、準備する手順が違います。商品ごとの作り方をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Raw rice and ready-cooked products require different preparation steps. Please look at each product’s instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回はパックの案内を読みます。外袋と中の容器を全部一緒に温めるとは考えず、開け方も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調理済みの商品について、包装の開け方や温め方を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read the pack’s instructions this time. I will not assume the outer bag and inner container should all be heated together, and I want to check how to open it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check how to open the packaging and heat the ready-cooked product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 加熱方法と包装の扱いを確認してください。どれくらい買う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the heating method and how to handle the packaging. How much are you planning to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず一食分で使い方を確かめます。便利そうだから大量に買うより、保管する場所も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保管できる量を考え、まとめ買いする前に一食分を試したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will first check how to use it with one serving. Rather than buy a lot because it looks convenient, I want to consider storage space too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to consider how much you can store and try one serving before buying in bulk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の使い方に合う量でお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose an amount that suits how you will use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 生米と調理済みを区別し、パックの開け方と加熱の表示を読みます。今日は一食分だけ試す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米の種類、包装の開け方、加熱表示を確認し、まず一食分を試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish raw rice from ready-cooked rice and read the pack’s opening and heating instructions. Today I plan to try only one serving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the rice type, how to open the packaging, and the heating instructions, and first try one serving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示でお困りでしたらお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask if you need help with the labels. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仲間と音楽の練習をしたいです。スピーカーを使わなければ、どこでも演奏してよいのか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仲間と音楽を練習したいので、スピーカーを使わなければ演奏してよいのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to practice music with friends. I want to ask whether we can play anywhere as long as we do not use a speaker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to practice music with friends and ask whether playing is allowed if you do not use a speaker. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの楽器を使い、何人で練習する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which instruments will you use, and how many people plan to practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 太鼓を二人で練習します。録音を流す予定はありませんが、生の音でも周りに響きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人で太鼓を練習し、録音は流さないが生の音でも周りに響きそうだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two of us will practice drums. We do not plan to play a recording, but the live sound seems likely to carry around the area too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that two of you will practice drums and will not play recordings, but the live sound may still carry to the surrounding area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この広場の掲示では、太鼓の練習はできません。録音を流さなくても、生の太鼓の練習ができるという条件ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sign for this plaza says drum practice is not permitted. Not playing a recording does not mean live drum practice is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前に注意されたので、今回は少し弱くたたけばよいと思っていました。でも許可されたという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前注意されたため弱くたたけばよいと思ったが、許可された意味ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We were cautioned before, so I thought this time we could just play more softly. But that does not mean we were given permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you thought playing softly would be acceptable after being cautioned before, but that did not mean permission had been granted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 音を小さくしても、この広場で太鼓の練習をしてよいという案内にはなりません。ここでは始めず、練習に利用できる別の施設をお探しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even at a lower volume, this does not become permission to practice drums in this plaza. Please do not start here; look for another facility available for practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。公園で難しければ、練習できる施設を探します。人が少ない時間なら勝手によいと考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件を確認するまで始めず、公園で難しければ別の施設を探し、人が少ないだけで演奏してよいとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. If it is difficult in the park, we will find a facility where we can practice. I will not assume we can play without permission just because few people are around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not start until checking the conditions, will find another facility if the park is unsuitable, and will not assume playing is allowed merely because few people are present. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる場所と条件を確認して計画を立てましょう。通路やほかの利用者への配慮も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us plan after checking the available places and their conditions. You also need to consider paths and other users.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日この広場では太鼓を演奏しません。二人で使える練習場所を探し、楽器の種類と人数を伝えて施設の条件を確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: この広場では今日は太鼓を演奏せず、二人で使える別の練習場所を探し、楽器と人数を伝えて利用条件を確認後に申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will not play drums in this plaza today. We will find another practice place for two people, explain the instrument and number of people, check the facility’s conditions, and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not play drums in this plaza today, will find another practice place for two, and will explain the instrument and number of people and check the conditions before applying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。条件を聞いてから場所をお選びください。太鼓を出さずにご確認いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask about the conditions before choosing a place. Thank you for checking without taking out the drums.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 砂川で友人と会う予定ですが、お互い見つかりません。二人とも駅にいるので、待ち合わせ場所を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅で友人と会う予定だがお互い見つからないため、待ち合わせ場所を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am supposed to meet a friend in Sunagawa, but we cannot find each other. We are both at the station, so I want to clarify our meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you planned to meet a friend at the station but cannot find each other and want to clarify the meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人は改札の内側ですか、外側ですか。ご自身はどちらにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your friend inside or outside the ticket gates? Where are you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は外です。友人は乗り換えの途中で、まだ改札の中にいるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は改札外にいて、乗り換え中の友人はまだ改札内にいると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am outside. My friend says they are still inside the gates while transferring trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are outside the ticket gates and your friend, who is transferring, is still inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ駅でも場所が分かれていますね。友人はここで降りる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You are in different areas even though it is the same station. Does your friend plan to end their train journey here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 降りずに次の列車へ乗ります。会うためだけに出てもらうと、乗り換えに影響するかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は下車せず次の列車に乗るため、会うために改札を出ると乗り換えに影響するかもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, they will take the next train rather than leave here. Asking them to come out just to meet me might affect their transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friend will continue on the next train rather than leave the station, so coming through the gates just to meet might affect their transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、移動する前に友人と予定を相談しましょう。列車の時間も本人の案内で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please discuss the plan with your friend before moving. Have them also check their train time using their own travel information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で話します。私は改札に入って追いかけず、友人にも探し回らずその場で予定を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話で予定を相談し、自分は改札に入って追いかけず、友人にも探し回らず確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will speak to them by phone. I will not go through the gates to chase after them, and I will ask them to stay where they are and check the plan rather than walk around searching.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss the plan by phone, will not go through the gates to chase your friend, and will ask your friend to check without walking around searching. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お互い動き続けると行き違いますね。会える条件が整わなければ、別の日にすることも相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you both keep moving, you may miss each other. If meeting is not practical, you can also discuss another day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は会うのをやめ、友人は乗り換えを続けることにしました。私は外に残り、別の日を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は会わず友人は乗り換えを続け、自分は改札外に残って別の日を相談すると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We decided not to meet today, and my friend will continue their transfer. I will stay outside and discuss another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you will not meet today, your friend will continue transferring, and you will remain outside the ticket gates and discuss another day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お友達にもお気をつけてとお伝えください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please tell your friend to take care too. Thank you for consulting us.
